notes: Corrected: הָיָה takes the perfect auxiliary 'have' of 'to have brought' rather than going unrepresented (rule 11/17); the copula 'was' of 'which was the reward' goes to the predicate לְ under rule 49 instead of being added with the supplied noun; 'for' before 'his tidings' joins the infinitive under rule 44 since בְּשֹׂרָה is its bare object.

Large-source-unit 'thinking' (בְּ + עֵינָי + suffix) reviewed and retained as noncompositional: no English word writes any morpheme's lexeme and the suffix's referent is carried inside the participle.
